meta.prompt: Compare two phone plans side by side. Lite: $25 a month, 10 GB data, 500 minutes of calls, roaming not included, monthly contract, no extras. Max: $45 a month, unlimited data, unlimited calls, roaming in the EU and US, 24-month contract, streaming and 5G included. Mark the better plan on each row (cheaper price, more data, more calls, roaming, shorter contract, more extras). Under the table a recommendation with one sentence that says how many of the six rows the recommended plan wins and how much more it costs per month, and a Choose button under each plan; once I choose, the card says which plan I picked.
meta.text:
ChatCard "Compare phone plans" "Lite vs Max" icon:"compare_arrows" status:"Compare"
  ComparisonTable names:["Lite","Max"] prices:["$25/mo","$45/mo"] rows:[["Data","10 GB","Unlimited",2],["Calls","500 min","Unlimited",2],["Roaming","Not included","EU and US",2],["Contract","Monthly","24 months",1],["Extras","None","Streaming and 5G",2],["Price","$25","$45",1]] pick:2 cta:"Choose" -> chosen=result
  Recommendation "Max is the better fit" "It wins 5 of the 6 rows (Contract is the exception) for $20 more per month." reasons:["Unlimited data and calls","Roaming in the EU and US","Streaming and 5G included"] eyebrow:"Recommended"
  if chosen!=""
    Receipt "Plan chosen" "You picked the {chosen} plan." tone:good icon:"check_circle"

state chosen=""
